title: Sody BTE Pack
description: This is a client-side modpack designed specifically for Build The Earth (BTE) Turkiye (potentially other teams as well) server.
body:
Here is the collection of mods and shaderpacks I personally use for the BTE Turkiye (potentially any other BTE server). The included shaderpacks (BSL and Photon) are fully compatible with Voxy. With this setup, you can easily run a 512-chunk render distance smoothly while shaders are active.

### Mods (Fabric)
* Accurate Block Placement Reborn
* Big Sign Writer
* Chat Heads
* Chunky
* Cloth Config
* CommandKeys
* Dark Loading Screen
* DCCH
* Entity Culling
* Fabric API
* Far Block Entity Rendering
* FerriteCore
* ImmediatelyFast
* Iris
* JourneyMap
* Krypton
* Lithium
* Longer Chat History
* Mod Menu
* OpenMineMap
* Reese's Sodium Options
* Sodium
* Sodium Extra
* Voxy
* Voxy Extra
* WI Zoom
* WorldEditCUI

### Shaderpacks (With versions that work with Voxy)
* BSL
* Photon
